notes: Diverged ~t=1.3e-5s (12-13 steps); crashed before forceCoeffs ever ran, so Cl/Cd unavailable not just inaccurate. Root cause: mesh non-orthogonality (max 83.9 deg) + nNonOrthogonalCorrectors=0, not the timestep.

Stopped ~t=0.0002s (2 steps) after nNonOrthogonalCorrectors fix but with deltaT jumped 100x in the same test; different failure mode (mean Courant elevated too -- plain CFL issue, not the non-orthogonality one). wall_time_s is the last ExecutionTime logged before the run stopped, not a full run.

First stable run, after Distance+Threshold mesh grading + recombine=True. wall_time_s is extrapolated from a partial log sample (log has since been overwritten by later reruns, so the exact final value can't be recovered). delta_p not captured -- no probe was set up before this run's data was overwritten.

Converged via residualControl at t=2.3591s. Restarted from t=0 at deltaT=1e-4 (10x bump from the 1e-5 test) once the mean/max Courant on that earlier run showed heavy headroom (mean 0.0006, max 0.0057) -- max_courant here is the true peak grepped across the full run, not a spot-check. Cd/Cl match the DFG 2D-1 benchmark closely (ref. Cd~5.57-5.59, Cl~0.0104-0.0110); delta_p=0.11702 vs. benchmark ref. ~0.1172 -- also a close match. delta_p from probes at (0.15,0.2)/(0.25,0.2), rho=1 (kinematic pressure).

DFG 2D-2 benchmark (Um=1.5 -> Ubar=1.0, Re=100): unsteady vortex shedding, run to fixed endTime=5s (residualControl never triggers by design -- flow doesn't reach a steady state). wall_time_s is the final ExecutionTime logged at t=5s (16-way parallel); max_courant is the true peak grepped across the full run. Stats from plot_results.py (see that script for the window rationale): Cd/Cl extrema use the saturated tail t>=4.0s (amplitude was still slowly growing from rest before that -- checked by eye and confirmed via per-cycle Cl max: 0.826, 0.891, 0.911, 0.945, 0.954, 0.953, nearly flat only by the last 1-2 cycles); Strouhal number uses the wider t>=3.0s window since shedding frequency is unaffected by the amplitude growth, giving more zero-crossings to average over. Results (t>=4.0s): Cd mean=3.2022, range=[3.1711,3.2337]; Cl range=[-1.0014,0.9675] (max|Cl|=1.0014). Strouhal (t>=3.0s, 5 periods): T=0.3325s -> St=D/(Ubar*T)=0.3007. Matches published DFG 2D-2 reference ranges closely (St~0.300, c_D,mean~3.2, c_L,max~1.0). delta_p corrected 2026-09-14 to follow the actual DFG benchmark definition -- NOT a plain time-average/range over the saturated window (that gave a misleadingly narrow-looking 2.453 mean/[2.4115,2.4946] range from mixing values across the oscillation). Benchmark defines delta_p = p(front)-p(rear) evaluated at t0+T/2, where t0 is a time at which Cl attains a local maximum. Found each Cl local max at t0>=4.0s (parabolic-vertex refinement for sub-sample accuracy: t0=4.3154s, 4.6480s, 4.9809s), evaluated at t0+T/2 using T=0.3325s from the Strouhal calc above (interpolated into the pressure-probe series; the third t0's half-period point falls past t=5s so only 2 of the 3 peaks contribute): delta_p samples [2.468752, 2.469314] -> mean 2.469033 (tight agreement, spread <0.001). delta_p from probes at (0.15,0.2)/(0.25,0.2), rho=1 (kinematic pressure); no established reference value tracked here (2D-2 benchmark literature this project consulted emphasizes St/Cd/Cl over delta_p) -- recorded for completeness/future comparison only.
